items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1960-03-15
items.q: Well, he was good. He was good. He was an all-around man.

ctx.x: Did you know Mario Filazzo? Yeah. A bass player? Yeah.

Well, he was good. He was good. He was an all-around man. Then you had Luba Prima. I had Luba Prima, Leon Prima. He was a legitimate. I had Luba Prima, Leon Prima, my little cousin Mike Lala. I had Tony this. I had more trumpet players.
Which Mike Lala are you talking about? The one they call Black Mike? Black Mike's my son. White Mike is your son? Yeah. My son, yeah. He plays a lot of trumpet.
